exclusion_detail: Lead 9k (abstract: 'compound 9k was the most effective'). Route from azithromycin: Ac2O (2) -> CDI (5, acylimidazolide + 11,12-cyclic carbonate) -> propargylamine/DBU -> MeOH deacetylation (7) -> CuAAC with 2-chlorobenzyl azide (8k) -> 4-methoxybenzylamine/pyridine HCl (9k), plus preparation of the azide: at least 6 reactions.

lead.label: 9k
lead.why: Abstract: 'Particularly, compound 9k was the most effective (0.06, 0.03 and 0.125 ug/mL) against all the erythromycin-resistant S. pneumoniae'.

notes: Every target series needs azithromycin acetylation, CDI activation, carbamate formation, deacetylation and a triazole step (>=5). Azithromycin is purchased (Nexchem), so the exclusion is purely step count.
